{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Identify duplicate patients and keep only the highest sample_seq row per patient
# First, check how many patients have multiple rows
duplicate_patients = trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicate_patients.sum()}')

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df_clean = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f'After removing duplicates, data shape: {trial_df_clean.shape}')

# Recheck the distribution of severity by arm after deduplication
print('\nSeverity distribution by arm (after deduplication):')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).round(3))"}
